# Valid commands an agent typically runs. fluent must NEVER block any of these.
# One command per line; blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.

# --- git
git status
git status -sb
git status --short --branch
git status --porcelain
git status --porcelain=v1
git log --oneline -10
git log --oneline --graph --decorate --all
git log -n 5 --pretty=format:"%h %an %s"
git log --since="2 weeks ago" --author="Bruno"
git log --stat -3
git log -p -- path/to/file.py
git log --follow -- README.md
git log --no-merges --format=%H origin/main..HEAD
git log -S'needle' --oneline
git log --grep=fix --oneline
git log --name-only -1
git log --reverse --format="%ad %s" --date=short
git log --onel
git diff
git diff --staged
git diff --cached --stat
git diff HEAD~1 -- src/
git diff --name-only main...HEAD
git diff --word-diff
git diff --color-words

git show HEAD

git show HEAD:README.md
git add -A

git add -p
git add --all src/
git commit -m "fix: handle empty input"
git commit -am "wip"
git commit --amend --no-edit
git commit --allow-empty -m "trigger"
git commit -m "x" --no-verify
git checkout -b feature/x
git checkout main
git checkout -- file.txt
git switch -c new-branch
git switch main
git restore --staged file.txt
git restore file.txt
git branch
git branch -a

git branch --show-current
git branch -d merged-branch
git branch --merged main
git merge --no-ff feature

git rebase main

git rebase --continue

git pull --rebase
git pull origin main
git fetch --all --prune
git fetch origin --tags
git push origin main
git push -u origin feature/x
git push --set-upstream origin HEAD
git push origin --delete old-branch
git push --tags
git stash
git stash push -m "wip" --include-untracked
git stash list
git stash pop
git stash apply stash@{0}
git tag -a v1.0 -m "release"
git tag --list "v*"
git remote -v
git remote add origin https://github.com/x/y.git
git remote set-url origin git@github.com:x/y.git
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/x/y.git
git clone --branch main --single-branch https://github.com/x/y.git dir
git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD
git rev-parse --show-toplevel

git blame -L 10,20 file.py
git cherry-pick -x abc123
git reset --soft HEAD~1
git reset HEAD file.txt
git revert --no-edit HEAD
git clean -n
git config --global user.name "Bruno"
git config --get remote.origin.url
git config --list --show-origin
git -C repo status
git -c core.pager=cat log -1
git --no-pager log -5 --oneline

git describe --tags --abbrev=0

git submodule update --init --recursive
git bisect start

git grep -n "TODO" -- "*.py"

# --- ffmpeg
ffmpeg -i in.mp4 out.webm
ffmpeg -y -i in.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 23 -preset slow -c:a aac -b:a 128k out.mp4
ffmpeg -hide_banner -i in.mp4
ffmpeg -hide_banner -y -i in.mp4 out.mp4
ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -vf "scale=1280:-2" out.mp4
ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -ss 00:00:10 -t 5 -c copy clip.mp4
ffmpeg -ss 30 -i in.mp4 -frames:v 1 thumb.png
ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -vn -acodec libmp3lame -q:a 2 out.mp3
ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -an -c:v copy silent.mp4
ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -map 0:v -map 0:a:0 -c copy out.mkv
ffmpeg -f concat -safe 0 -i list.txt -c copy joined.mp4
ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -filter_complex "[0:v]split=2[a][b]" -map "[a]" a.mp4 -map "[b]" b.mp4
ffmpeg -framerate 30 -i img%03d.png -pix_fmt yuv420p out.mp4
ffmpeg -i in.wav -ar 44100 -ac 2 out.wav
ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -r 24 out.mp4
ffmpeg -loglevel error -i in.mp4 -f null -
ffmpeg -nostdin -i in.mp4 out.mkv
ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -movflags +faststart out.mp4
ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -b:v 2M -maxrate 2M -bufsize 1M out.mp4
ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -vf fps=1 frames/%04d.jpg
ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -metadata title="My video" out.mp4
ffmpeg -stream_loop -1 -i in.mp4 -t 60 out.mp4
ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -af "volume=1.5" out.mp4
ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -s 640x360 out.mp4
ffmpeg -rtsp_transport tcp -i rtsp://cam/stream -t 10 out.mp4
ffmpeg -re -i in.mp4 -f flv rtmp://server/live
ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -threads 4 out.mp4
ffmpeg -version
ffmpeg -encoders
ffmpeg -h encoder=libx264
ffmpeg -i a.mp4 -i b.wav -shortest -c:v copy -c:a aac out.mp4
ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -c:v libx264 -tune film -profile:v high out.mp4
ffmpeg -i in.gif -movflags faststart -pix_fmt yuv420p out.mp4
ffmpeg -nostats -progress pipe:1 -i in.mp4 out.mp4
ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf:v 20 out.mp4

# --- curl
curl https://example.com
curl -sS https://api.github.com/repos/x/y
curl -fsSL https://example.com/install.sh -o install.sh
curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"a":1}' https://httpbin.org/post
curl --request PUT --data-binary @file.json https://x
curl -I https://example.com
curl --head https://example.com
curl -L --max-time 10 --retry 3 https://x
curl -u user:pass https://x
curl --header "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://x
curl -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://x
curl --compressed https://x
curl -k https://self-signed.local
curl --connect-timeout 5 https://x
curl -F "file=@photo.jpg" https://x/upload
curl --data-urlencode "q=hello world" https://x
curl -s https://x | jq .
curl --json '{"a":1}' https://x
curl -v https://x
curl --fail-with-body https://x
curl -C - -O https://x/file.iso
curl --resolve example.com:443:127.0.0.1 https://example.com
curl --http2 https://x
curl --silent --show-error https://x
curl -A "fluent-test" https://x

# --- tar
tar -czf archive.tar.gz dir/
tar -xzf archive.tar.gz -C /tmp/out
tar -tvf archive.tar
tar czf backup.tgz src
tar -cJf a.tar.xz dir
tar --exclude='*.log' -czf a.tgz dir
tar -xf a.tar --strip-components=1
tar --list --file=a.tar
tar -czvf a.tgz --exclude=node_modules .
tar -xzf a.tgz --wildcards '*.txt'
tar -cf - dir | gzip > a.tgz
tar --create --gzip --file a.tgz dir
tar -xvf a.tar.bz2
tar --extract --file=a.tar --directory=out
tar -rf a.tar newfile

# --- jq
jq .
jq -r '.name' data.json
jq '.items[] | {id, name}' data.json
jq -c '.[]' data.json
jq --arg name "Bruno" '.[] | select(.name == $name)' data.json
jq -s 'add' a.json b.json
jq -n '{a: 1}'
jq --raw-output '.url'
jq -e '.ok' resp.json
jq --sort-keys . data.json
jq -S . data.json
jq --argjson n 3 '.[:$n]' data.json
jq -r '.[] | @csv' data.json
jq --tab . data.json
jq --indent 4 . data.json

# --- rsync
rsync -av src/ dst/
rsync -avz --delete src/ user@host:/backup/
rsync -av --exclude='node_modules' --exclude=.git ./ dst/
rsync -a --progress big.iso /mnt/usb/
rsync -avh --dry-run src/ dst/
rsync -e "ssh -p 2222" -av src/ host:dst/
rsync -av --partial --append-verify src dst
rsync -rlptD --chmod=Du+rwx src/ dst/
rsync --archive --verbose --human-readable src/ dst/
rsync -a --info=progress2 src/ dst/
rsync -av --include='*.py' --exclude='*' src/ dst/
rsync -avc src/ dst/
rsync -a --link-dest=../prev src/ snap/
rsync -az --bwlimit=1000 src/ host:dst/
rsync -av --remove-source-files src/ dst/

# --- mixed, wrapped, piped
cd repo && git pull && docker compose up -d
git log --oneline | head -5
curl -s https://x | jq -r .name
for f in *.wav; do ffmpeg -i "$f" "${f%.wav}.mp3"; done
sudo docker ps -a
GIT_PAGER=cat git log -3
timeout 60 curl -fsS https://x
bash -lc "git status && git diff --stat"
docker ps -q | xargs docker stop
git diff --stat && git commit -am "x" && git push
ffmpeg -i "$IN" $EXTRA_FLAGS out.mp4
git log $GIT_FLAGS

# --- curl: its man page says every boolean option is turned off with --no-<option>
# (and on again with the plain name), and any option can be prefixed with --expand-
curl --no-include https://example.com
curl --no-location -o page.html https://example.com
curl -sS --no-progress-meter -o items.json https://api.example.com/items
curl --progress-meter -o big.iso https://example.com/big.iso
curl --buffer https://example.com
curl --clobber -o page.html https://example.com
curl https://example.com/a --next https://example.com/b
curl --expand-url 'https://example.com/{{id}}' --variable id=42

# --- rsync: "--no-OPTION  turn off an implied OPTION (e.g. --no-D)"
rsync -a --no-perms src/ dst/
rsync -a --no-owner --no-group src/ backup/
rsync -a --no-D src/ dst/
rsync -a --no-times --checksum src/ dst/

# --- bsdtar: the tar macOS ships (libarchive); most options are only in its mdoc man page
bsdtar -xzf app.tar.gz --strip-components 1 -C out
bsdtar --exclude-vcs -czf src.tgz .
bsdtar -cf - --numeric-owner dir
bsdtar -tvf a.tar --include '*.py'
bsdtar --create --file a.tar --verbose dir
bsdtar --extract --file a.tar --directory out
bsdtar -xf a.tar --to-stdout notes.txt
bsdtar -cf a.tar --no-xattrs --no-mac-metadata dir
bsdtar --zstd -cf a.tar.zst dir
bsdtar --version
